description: This Java class `Erf` provides methods for computing the error function erf, its complementary function erfc, their inverse functions, and the difference between erf values, all for mathematical computations related to error functions. It uses mathematical techniques such as the regularized gamma functions from the Gamma class and polynomial approximations for inverse functions.

classes.name: Erf
classes.description: Utility class that provides static methods to compute error functions, their inverses, and related operations.

methods.name: erf
methods.description: Calculates the error function erf(x) using the regularized gamma function; returns values between -1 and 1.

methods.name: erfc
methods.description: Calculates the complementary error function erfc(x) using the regularized gamma function; returns values between 0 and 2.

methods.name: erf
methods.description: Calculates the difference erf(x2) - erf(x1) using either erf or erfc for precision.

methods.name: erfInv
methods.description: Calculates the inverse error function erf^{-1}(x) using polynomial approximations based on the input value.

methods.name: erfcInv
methods.description: Calculates the inverse complementary error function erfc^{-1}(x) as 1 - erf^{-1}(x).
